messages.content: What is Mayandi_Manzil?

Mayandi_Manzil is a premium organic Tamil cuisine restaurant specializing in authentic traditional recipes made with 100% organic ingredients sourced directly from certified organic farms. We preserve ancient Tamil culinary traditions while promoting healthy, sustainable eating.
Where is Mayandi_Manzil located?
Mayandi_Manzil is located in the heart of Chennai, Tamil Nadu. We have branches in T. Nagar and Adyar, bringing authentic organic Tamil cuisine to food lovers across the city.
What makes Mayandi_Manzil special?

Mayandi_Manzil stands out for three key reasons: 1) We use only certified organic ingredients, 2) Our recipes are passed down through generations of Tamil families, and 3) We cook in traditional earthenware and bronze vessels to preserve authentic flavors and nutritional value.
Do you serve non-vegetarian food?

Yes, we serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian authentic Tamil dishes. Our non-veg menu includes organic chicken, goat, fish, and prawns sourced from certified organic farms and sustainable fisheries.
What is your most popular dish?

Our signature dish is the Chettinad Organic Chicken Curry, slow-cooked with 27 organic spices in traditional bronze vessels. It's served with hand-pounded red rice and organic ghee. Customers travel from across the city just for this dish!
Tell me about your breakfast menu

Our organic Tamil breakfast includes: Idli with 5 types of chutneys, Dosa varieties (Plain, Masala, Ghee Roast, Rava), Pongal with cashews and pepper, Upma with vegetables, Appam with stew, and Puttu with kadala curry. All made with organic ingredients and served hot.
What are your lunch timings?
We serve lunch from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM. Our lunch special includes unlimited organic meals served on banana leaves with 5 curries, sambar, rasam, curd, and payasam - all for ₹350 per person.
Do you have filter coffee?

Yes! We serve authentic South Indian filter coffee made with organic Arabica beans from Coorg and organic milk from our partner dairy farm. It's prepared the traditional way in brass filters and served in stainless steel tumblers.
What is Kongunadu cuisine?

Kongunadu cuisine is from the western region of Tamil Nadu. At Mayandi_Manzil, we specialize in authentic Kongunadu dishes like Arachi Vitta Sambar, Nattu Kozhi Kulambu (country chicken curry), and Kola Urundai (spicy meat balls) - all made with organic ingredients.
Do you use organic rice?

Absolutely! We use multiple varieties of organic rice including: Mappillai Samba (red rice), Karuppu Kavuni (black rice), Ponni rice, and traditional Seeraga Samba for biryani. All sourced directly from organic farmers in Thanjavur district.
What is Mappillai Samba rice?

Mappillai Samba is an ancient Tamil red rice variety known for its exceptional health benefits. Rich in iron, zinc, and antioxidants, it helps improve hemoglobin levels and stamina. We use organic Mappillai Samba in many of our traditional dishes at Mayandi_Manzil.
Tell me about your biryani

Our Organic Tamil Biryani is made with Seeraga Samba rice, organic meat/vegetables, and 18 authentic spices. We offer: Chicken Biryani, Mutton Biryani, Prawn Biryani, and Vegetable Biryani. Each is slow-cooked in traditional dum style for 45 minutes to perfection.
What vegetables do you use?

All our vegetables are 100% organic and sourced from certified farms in Ooty, Kodaikanal, and nearby villages. We use seasonal vegetables like drumstick, brinjal, ladies finger, bitter gourd, pumpkin, ash gourd, snake gourd, and traditional greens like moringa and amaranth leaves.
Do you have sambar powder?

Yes! Our signature organic sambar powder is handmade in-house using 15 traditional spices including coriander, cumin, fenugreek, black pepper, and red chilies - all organic. We also sell it packaged (₹250 for 250g) for home cooking.
What is Kuzhambu?

Kuzhambu is a traditional Tamil curry. At Mayandi_Manzil, we serve several varieties: Vatha Kuzhambu (tamarind-based), Mor Kuzhambu (yogurt-based), Puli Kuzhambu (tangy tamarind), and Milagu Kuzhambu (pepper curry). All made with organic ingredients and served with steamed rice.
Do you serve Chettinad food?

Yes! Chettinad cuisine is one of our specialties. We serve authentic dishes like Chettinad Chicken, Mutton Chukka, Pepper Chicken, Kara Kulambu, and Chettinad Fish Fry - all prepared with organic ingredients and traditional stone-ground masalas.
What is your spice level?

Authentic Tamil food is naturally spicy, but we customize spice levels from mild to extra spicy based on customer preference. Just inform our staff when ordering. We use organic red chilies and fresh green chilies from our partner farms.
Do you have rasam varieties?

We serve 7 types of traditional rasam: Tomato Rasam, Pepper Rasam, Garlic Rasam, Lemon Rasam, Pineapple Rasam, Jeera Rasam, and Paruppu Rasam. Each is made fresh daily with organic ingredients and temple-grade spices.
What is Mor Kuzhambu?

Mor Kuzhambu is a traditional Tamil yogurt-based curry made with organic curd, coconut, green chilies, and curry leaves. We temper it with mustard, fenugreek, and red chilies. It's cooling, probiotic-rich, and pairs perfectly with steamed organic rice.
Do you serve parotta?

Yes! Our organic wheat parottas are made fresh throughout the day using organic whole wheat flour and organic ghee. We serve them with: Salna (veg/non-veg gravy), Kurma, Chicken Curry, or Mutton Curry. Available from 6 PM to 11 PM.
What is your dinner menu?

Our dinner menu features: Variety Rice (Lemon, Tomato, Tamarind, Coconut), Parotta with curries, Dosa varieties, Biryani, Chettinad specials, and authentic Tamil meals. We also have live counters for Kothu Parotta and Egg dishes. Dinner served 6 PM - 11 PM.
Do you make kothu parotta?

Yes! Our Kothu Parotta is a customer favorite. We make it fresh at our live counter using hand-shredded organic parottas tossed with eggs, vegetables, organic chicken/mutton, and special masala. Available in Veg, Egg, Chicken, and Mutton variants.
What is your pricing?

Our prices reflect the premium organic quality: Breakfast items ₹80-150, Lunch meals ₹350-500, Biryani ₹280-450, Curries ₹180-350, Dosa ₹120-200, Parotta ₹25 per piece. Unlimited meals are ₹350 for veg, ₹450 for non-veg.
Do you have catering services?

Yes! Mayandi_Manzil offers premium organic catering for weddings, corporate events, and private parties. We cater from 50 to 5000 guests with authentic Tamil cuisine. We also provide traditional banana leaf service and experienced serving staff.
What is your minimum order for catering?

Our minimum catering order is for 50 people. For corporate lunches and small events (50-200), we charge ₹450 per person. For weddings and large events (200+), pricing starts at ₹550 per person including setup and service.
Do you deliver food?

Yes, we deliver across Chennai via our own fleet of delivery vehicles to maintain food quality. Delivery is free for orders above ₹500 within 5km. We're also available on Swiggy and Zomato. Order directly for 10% discount.
What are your opening hours?
Mayandi_Manzil is open 7 days a week: Breakfast: 7 AM - 11 AM, Lunch: 12 PM - 3:30 PM, Evening Snacks: 4 PM - 6 PM, Dinner: 6 PM - 11 PM. Both our T. Nagar and Adyar branches follow the same timings.
Do you have parking?

Yes, both our branches have complimentary valet parking. T. Nagar branch has covered parking for 20 cars, and Adyar branch has parking for 30 cars. We also have two-wheeler parking available at both locations.
Is there AC seating?

Yes, we have both AC and non-AC seating areas. Our AC section can seat 80 people and is perfect for family dining. The non-AC section has traditional ambiance with 60 seats and provides an authentic village-style dining experience.
Do you serve alcohol?

No, Mayandi_Manzil is a pure vegetarian and non-vegetarian restaurant without alcohol service. We focus on authentic Tamil cuisine and traditional beverages like nannari sherbet, panakam, buttermilk, and fresh juices.
What are your traditional drinks?

We serve authentic Tamil beverages: Nannari Sherbet (cooling root drink), Panakam (jaggery drink), Neer Mor (spiced buttermilk), Fresh Coconut Water, Ellu Koozh (finger millet drink), Karupatti Coffee (palm jaggery coffee), and seasonal drinks like Mango Panakam and Rose Milk.
What is Nannari?

Nannari is an indigenous root (Indian Sarsaparilla) used to make a cooling summer drink. Our organic Nannari Sherbet is made with nannari extract, organic jaggery, and lime - excellent for beating Chennai's heat and has numerous health benefits including blood purification.
Do you have desserts?

Yes! Our traditional Tamil desserts include: Payasam (5 varieties), Kesari, Halwa (carrot, wheat, ghee), Mysore Pak, Adhirasam, Badusha, and seasonal specials like Paal Payasam and Semiya Payasam. All made with organic ingredients and pure ghee.
What is Paal Payasam?

Paal Payasam is a rich Tamil dessert made with organic rice, full-cream organic milk, organic jaggery, cardamom, and garnished with cashews and raisins fried in pure ghee. At Mayandi_Manzil, we slow-cook it for 2 hours in bronze vessels for authentic taste.
Do you use palm jaggery?

Yes! We use both organic palm jaggery (karupatti) and sugarcane jaggery in our cooking. Palm jaggery is rich in minerals and has a lower glycemic index. We use it in payasams, coffee, and traditional sweets. We also sell packaged organic palm jaggery (₹180/kg).
What oils do you use for cooking?

We use traditional cold-pressed organic oils: Sesame oil (gingelly) for most curries, Groundnut oil for frying, Coconut oil for tempering, and pure Cow Ghee for biryanis and sweets. All are chemical-free and sourced from organic certified suppliers.
Do you have cooking classes?

Yes! Mayandi_Manzil conducts weekend cooking classes where you can learn authentic Tamil recipes. Classes are ₹2,500 per person for a 3-hour session including ingredients, recipe booklet, and lunch. We teach 5-6 dishes per session. Advance booking required.
What is your signature thali?

Our Mayandi_Manzil Grand Thali includes: 2 types of rice, 5 curries, sambar, rasam, kootu, poriyal, appalam, pickle, curd, and payasam - all served on a banana leaf with unlimited refills. Available for lunch (₹350 veg, ₹450 non-veg).
What is kootu?

Kootu is a traditional Tamil dish made with lentils and vegetables in a coconut-spice paste. We serve several varieties: Chow Chow Kootu, Avarakkai Kootu, Beans Kootu, and Kadala Kootu. It's protein-rich, mild, and perfect with rice and sambar.
What is poriyal?

Poriyal is a dry stir-fried vegetable dish tempered with mustard, urad dal, and curry leaves. We make it with organic vegetables like beans, cabbage, carrot, beetroot, and traditional greens. It's a nutritious, low-oil side dish essential in Tamil meals.
Do you serve Idiyappam?

Yes! Our organic Idiyappam (string hoppers) are made fresh daily with hand-pounded rice flour. We serve them with: Coconut Milk & Sugar, Vegetable Stew, Chicken Stew, Egg Curry, or Mutton Curry. Available for breakfast and dinner.
What is your fish menu?

Our organic fish menu includes: Meen Kuzhambu (fish curry), Meen Varuval (fish fry), Meen Pollichathu (fish in banana leaf), Vanjaram Fry (king fish), and Pomfret Fry. We use fresh fish from sustainable sources, marinated with organic spices.
Do you have prawn dishes?

Yes! We serve: Eral Masala (prawn masala), Eral Varuval (prawn fry), Eral Kuzhambu (prawn curry), and Eral Biriyani. All prawns are sourced from organic aquaculture farms in Nagapattinam and prepared with traditional Chettinad spices.
What is Varuval?

Varuval is a traditional Tamil dry fry preparation where meat/fish/vegetables are marinated with spices and roasted until crispy. Our popular varuvals include: Chicken Varuval, Mutton Varuval, Fish Varuval, Prawn Varuval, and Mushroom Varuval - all using organic ingredients.
Do you serve mutton?

Yes! We use organic goat meat from certified farms. Our mutton dishes include: Mutton Kuzhambu, Mutton Chukka, Mutton Biryani, Mutton Varuval, Nalli Mutton (bone marrow), and Aattu Kaal Soup (goat leg soup) - all slow-cooked to perfection.
What is Aattu Kaal Soup?

Aattu Kaal Soup is a traditional Tamil soup made from organic goat trotters slow-cooked for 6+ hours with peppercorns, ginger, garlic, and spices. Rich in collagen and minerals, it's considered highly nutritious and is served hot as an appetizer (₹180 per bowl).
Do you have organic certification?

Yes! All our ingredients are sourced from suppliers with organic certification from India Organic, USDA Organic, or EU Organic standards. We maintain complete traceability and can show certification documents on request. Food safety license: FSSAI 10012043000123.
How do you ensure organic quality?

We maintain strict quality control: 1) Direct procurement from certified organic farmers, 2) Regular testing of ingredients, 3) Segregated storage to prevent cross-contamination, 4) Traditional cooking methods without chemicals, 5) Quarterly third-party audits. We're transparent about our sourcing.
Can I buy your spices?

Yes! We sell our signature organic spice mixes: Sambar Powder (₹250/250g), Rasam Powder (₹220/200g), Chettinad Masala (₹280/200g), Biryani Masala (₹300/200g), and Curry Powder (₹200/200g). Available at both branches and for online order.
Do you have combo meals?

Yes! We offer value combos: Breakfast Combo (Idli + Dosa + Coffee - ₹180), Lunch Combo (Rice + 2 Curries + Rasam + Curd - ₹220), Dinner Combo (2 Parotta + Curry + Curd - ₹200), and Family Combo for 4 (₹1,500). All include unlimited refills.
What is your weekend special?

Every weekend we feature regional specialties: Saturday - Kongunadu Special (Nattu Kozhi, Arachi Vitta Sambar), Sunday - Chettinad Feast (Pepper Chicken, Mutton Chukka, Kara Kulambu). These rotating specials showcase authentic flavors from different Tamil regions.
Do you celebrate Pongal festival?

Yes! During Pongal festival, we offer special traditional dishes: Sakkarai Pongal, Ven Pongal, Vada, Medu Vadai, special Kolams (rangoli), and serve traditional payasam. We also conduct clay pot Pongal cooking demonstrations. It's a grand celebration of Tamil harvest festival!
What is Sakkarai Pongal?

Sakkarai Pongal is a sweet dish made with organic rice, moong dal, organic jaggery, cardamom, and lots of pure ghee, garnished with cashews and raisins. We prepare it fresh in bronze pots and serve it hot during breakfast and as prasadam during Pongal festival.
Do you have kids menu?

Yes! Our kids-friendly menu includes: Mini Dosa, Idli with mild sambar, Ghee Rice, Curd Rice, Sweet Pongal, Kesari, Fruit Salad, and Badam Milk. All portions are smaller and less spicy. We also provide high chairs and a small play area.
What is Curd Rice?

Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam) is a cooling Tamil comfort food made with organic rice, fresh organic curd, tempered with mustard, curry leaves, ginger, and green chilies. We add pomegranate and grapes for kids. Perfect for hot days and easy on digestion.
Do you have vegan options?

Yes! We have extensive vegan options: All dosas and idlis (without ghee), Vegetable Curries, Sambar, Rasam, Poriyal, Kootu, Variety Rice (lemon, tamarind), Veg Biryani, and Coconut-based desserts. Just mention 'vegan' when ordering and we'll ensure no dairy/ghee.
What is your organic ghee source?

Our pure cow ghee is sourced from an organic dairy in Kanchipuram where cows are grass-fed and raised without hormones or antibiotics. The ghee is made using traditional Bilona method - hand-churned from curd. We use it in biryanis, sweets, and tadkas.
Do you serve Appam?

Yes! Our fermented Appam (rice pancakes) are made with organic rice batter and coconut milk. We serve them with: Vegetable Stew, Chicken Stew, Mutton Stew, Egg Curry, or Coconut Milk & Sugar. The appams are soft, fluffy, and have crispy edges.
What is your chicken curry recipe?

Our signature Chettinad Chicken Curry uses free-range organic chicken marinated in 27 spices including fennel, star anise, stone flower, bay leaf, cinnamon, cloves, and stone-ground masala. Slow-cooked in bronze vessels with organic tomatoes, onions, and coconut milk for rich flavor.
Do you have gluten-free options?

Yes! Many Tamil dishes are naturally gluten-free: Idli, Dosa, Appam, Idiyappam, all rice varieties, Puttu (rice flour), and most curries. We also have Ragi Dosa and Millet-based items. Please inform our staff about gluten sensitivity when ordering.
What is Ragi?

Ragi (Finger Millet) is a super grain rich in calcium and iron. At Mayandi_Manzil, we serve organic Ragi Dosa, Ragi Mudde (finger millet balls), Ragi Koozh (porridge), and Ragi Puttu. These are traditional Tamil health foods excellent for diabetics and growing children.
Do you have diabetic-friendly food?

Yes! We offer diabetic-friendly options: Brown rice meals, Ragi items, Steamed dishes, Low-oil curries, Sugar-free desserts with stevia, and meals prepared with minimal oil. We can customize spice levels and cooking methods. Please consult our nutrition advisor for personalized meal planning.
What is Aviyal?

Aviyal is a traditional Kerala-Tamil mixed vegetable dish in coconut-yogurt gravy. We make it with organic vegetables like drumstick, raw banana, yam, carrot, beans, and snake gourd, ground with coconut, green chili, and cumin, tempered with coconut oil and curry leaves.
Do you serve Dosa varieties?

We have 15+ dosa varieties: Plain Dosa, Masala Dosa, Ghee Roast, Onion Dosa, Rava Dosa, Podi Dosa, Mysore Masala, Set Dosa, Neer Dosa, Paper Dosa, Paneer Dosa, Cheese Dosa, Egg Dosa, Chicken Dosa, and our special 70 Mm Dosa (2 feet long!).
What is 70 Mm Dosa?

Our famous 70 Mm Dosa is a 2-feet long crispy dosa made with organic rice batter, served with potato masala, 3 types of chutney, and sambar. It's a visual spectacle and perfect for sharing. Available after 6 PM, must be pre-ordered (₹250). Great for Instagram photos!
What chutneys do you serve?

We serve 7 traditional chutneys: Coconut Chutney, Tomato Chutney, Onion Chutney, Mint Chutney, Coriander Chutney, Peanut Chutney, and our special Podi (spice powder) with sesame oil. All made fresh daily with organic ingredients.
What is Podi?

Podi (also called Milagai Podi or Gun Powder) is a traditional Tamil spice mix made with roasted lentils, red chilies, sesame seeds, asafoetida, and curry leaves. We serve it with idli, dosa, and rice mixed with sesame oil. We also sell packaged podi (₹180/200g).
Do you have corporate lunch packages?

Yes! We offer corporate lunch packages for offices: Standard Package (₹200/person) - Rice, 2 curries, sambar, curd, pickle; Premium Package (₹300/person) - adds biryani, raita, payasam; Executive Package (₹400/person) - full meals with non-veg options. Minimum 20 orders. Free delivery within 10km.
Can I book for private parties?

Yes! Both our branches are available for private parties. We can host up to 100 guests in AC section. Party packages start at ₹600 per person including venue, unlimited food, traditional music, and decoration. We specialize in birthdays, anniversaries, and family gatherings.
Do you provide wedding catering?

Yes! Mayandi_Manzil is renowned for authentic Tamil wedding catering. We provide: Traditional banana leaf service, multi-cuisine menu, live counters, experienced serving staff, and traditional vessels. We've catered 500+ weddings. Packages from ₹550-1000 per person. Free tasting for bookings above 500 guests.
What is your wedding menu?

Our Tamil wedding menu includes: 4 types of rice, 8 curries (veg & non-veg), 2 types of sambar, rasam, kootu, 3 poriyals, vadai, appalam, 3 types of pickles, papad, banana chips, curd, buttermilk, and 3 types of payasam. Served traditionally on banana leaves with unlimited refills.
Do you use banana leaves?

Yes! We serve traditional meals on organic banana leaves sourced from local farmers. Eating on banana leaves is not only eco-friendly but also adds subtle flavor and has health benefits. The leaves are washed and sterilized before use. Perfect for authentic Tamil dining experience.
What is your seating capacity?

T. Nagar branch seats 140 people (80 AC + 60 non-AC), Adyar branch seats 180 people (120 AC + 60 non-AC). We also have private dining rooms for 15-20 people in each branch. Advance booking recommended for groups above 10 on weekends.
Do you accept reservations?

Yes, we accept reservations via phone, WhatsApp, or our website. Advance booking is recommended for: Weekend dinners, large groups (8+), private dining rooms, and festival days. Call T. Nagar: +91-9876543210 or Adyar: +91-9876543211. Online booking gets 5% discount.
What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all payment methods: Cash, Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), UPI (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm), Digital Wallets, and Sodexo/Ticket Restaurant meal vouchers. We also offer monthly billing for corporate customers.
Do you have loyalty program?

Yes! Join Mayandi_Manzil Loyalty Club free of charge. Benefits: 10% discount on all orders, birthday month special offer, early access to cooking classes, quarterly free meal, and exclusive invitations to food tasting events. Earn 1 point per ₹100 spent, redeem for discounts.
What is Lemon Rice?

Our Lemon Rice is made with organic Ponni rice tempered with mustard, curry leaves, peanuts, and turmeric, mixed with fresh lemon juice. Light, tangy, and perfect for lunch boxes. We also add cashews fried in ghee for extra flavor. Available as part of variety rice menu.
Do you serve Tamarind Rice?

Yes! Our Puliyodharai (Tamarind Rice) is a tangy South Indian favorite made with organic rice, tamarind extract, peanuts, sesame seeds, and traditional spices. Tempered with mustard, curry leaves, and red chilies. It's preservative-free and stays fresh for 2 days.
What is Tomato Rice?

Tomato Rice is a flavorful variety rice made with organic basmati rice, fresh organic tomatoes, onions, mint, and coriander. Spiced with garam masala and tempered with ghee. Pairs perfectly with raita and papad. A wholesome one-pot meal option.
Do you have Coconut Rice?

Yes! Our Coconut Rice (Thengai Sadam) is made with organic rice, fresh coconut, cashews, curry leaves, and tempered with mustard and green chilies. Mildly spiced and aromatic. We also serve it as prasadam style with jaggery for a sweet-savory combination.
What is Bisi Bele Bath?

Bisi Bele Bath is a traditional Karnataka-Tamil one-pot meal made with rice, lentils, mixed organic vegetables, tamarind, and special spice blend. Served hot with ghee, boondi, and potato chips. Rich, comforting, and nutritious - available in our lunch menu.
Do you serve Upma varieties?

Yes! We serve: Rava Upma (semolina), Vermicelli Upma, Broken Wheat Upma, and Oats Upma - all made with organic ingredients. Loaded with vegetables, cashews, and curry leaves. Healthy breakfast option served with coconut chutney and sambar.
What is Pongal dish?

We serve two types: Ven Pongal (savory) - made with rice and moong dal, tempered with pepper, cumin, ginger, and cashews; Sakkarai Pongal (sweet) - made with rice, dal, jaggery, and ghee. Both are traditional breakfast dishes served hot with sambar and chutney.
Do you have Puttu?

Yes! Our traditional Kerala-Tamil Puttu is made with organic rice flour and fresh coconut, steamed in cylindrical molds. Served with: Kadala Curry (black chickpea), Banana, Sugar & Ghee, or Paruppu (dal). Available for breakfast and dinner.
What is Kadala Curry?

Kadala Curry is a Kerala-Tamil black chickpea curry made with organic chickpeas slow-cooked in coconut gravy with fennel, star anise, and curry leaves. Rich in protein and fiber. Perfect accompaniment for Puttu, Appam, and Idiyappam. Vegan and nutritious.
Do you have Medu Vada?

Yes! Our crispy Medu Vada (urad dal donuts) are made fresh throughout the day. Crispy outside, soft inside, flavored with pepper, cumin, curry leaves, and ginger. Served hot with sambar and coconut chutney. Also available as part of tiffin combos.
What is Sambar Vada?

Sambar Vada is a popular comfort food where crispy medu vadas are soaked in hot organic sambar, topped with ghee and served with onions. The vadas absorb the sambar flavors while maintaining slight crispiness. Perfect for breakfast or evening snack.
Do you serve Bajji?

Yes! Our evening snack menu features: Onion Bajji, Potato Bajji, Chili Bajji, Banana Bajji, and Mixed Vegetable Bajji - all made with organic chickpea flour batter and fried in cold-pressed groundnut oil. Served hot with coconut chutney and mint chutney.
What are your evening snacks?

Evening snacks (4 PM - 6 PM): Various Bajjis, Bonda, Samosa, Cutlet, Murukku, Mixture, Ribbon Pakoda, and fresh snacks like Masala Vada and Vadai. We also serve filter coffee, tea, and traditional drinks. Perfect for tea-time with family!
Do you make Murukku?

Yes! We make traditional hand-pressed Murukku using organic rice flour, urad dal flour, butter, and spices. Available in: Plain Murukku, Kai Murukku, Thenkuzhal, and Butter Murukku. Fresh batches made daily. Also available in 500g packs for ₹250.
What is your environmental policy?

Mayandi_Manzil is committed to sustainability: We use banana leaves instead of plastic, composting of organic waste, rainwater harvesting, solar panels for 30% power, eco-friendly packaging for takeaways, partnership with organic farmers, and zero-waste kitchen practices.
Do you support local farmers?

Absolutely! We directly source from 50+ certified organic farmers in Tamil Nadu (Thanjavur, Madurai, Ooty, Salem districts). We pay fair prices, provide advance orders, and help with organic certification. Supporting local organic farming is core to Mayandi_Manzil's mission.
What is your takeaway packaging?

We use eco-friendly packaging: Biodegradable containers made from sugarcane bagasse, paper bags instead of plastic, reusable cloth bags for spice purchases, and traditional banana leaf wrapping for sweets. We encourage customers to bring own containers for 5% discount.
Do you have gift vouchers?

Yes! Mayandi_Manzil gift vouchers make perfect gifts for food lovers. Available in denominations of ₹500, ₹1000, ₹2000, and ₹5000. Valid for 1 year, can be used for dining, catering, cooking classes, or purchasing our organic products. Buy online or at our branches.
Can I franchise Mayandi_Manzil?

Yes, we're expanding through franchise model! Requirements: Minimum 2000 sq ft space, investment of ₹50 lakhs, commitment to organic standards, and passion for Tamil cuisine. We provide: Training, recipes, supplier network, branding, and operations support. Contact franchising@mayandimanzil.com
What are your social media handles?

Follow us for daily food updates, recipes, and offers: Instagram @mayandi_manzil, Facebook /MayandiManzilOfficial, YouTube Mayandi Manzil Recipes, Twitter @MayandiManzil. Share your food photos with #MayandiManzilExperience and get featured!
Do you have online ordering?

Yes! Order directly from our website www.mayandimanzil.com for 10% discount, or through Swiggy and Zomato. Our own app (iOS/Android) offers exclusive deals, loyalty points tracking, and pre-ordering for pickup. Download for ₹100 off on first order!
What is your customer feedback rating?

We're proud of our ratings: Google - 4.8/5 (3500+ reviews), Zomato - 4.7/5 (Gold rated), Swiggy - 4.6/5, TripAdvisor - Certificate of Excellence. Customer satisfaction is our priority. We personally respond to all feedback within 24 hours.
Do you have chef recommendations?

Our Head Chef Murugan (25+ years experience) recommends: First-timers: Try Grand Thali; Spice lovers: Chettinad Chicken; Health conscious: Ragi Dosa with Avial; Adventurous: Nalli Mutton; Traditional: Unlimited Meals on Banana Leaf. Every dish tells a story of Tamil culinary heritage!
What makes Tamil food unique?

Tamil cuisine is unique for: Ancient recipes (2000+ years old), perfect balance of 6 tastes (sweet, sour, salty, bitter, pungent, astringent), use of indigenous spices, cooking in traditional vessels (bronze, clay), emphasis on seasonal eating, and Ayurvedic principles. Mayandi_Manzil preserves this heritage authentically.
Tell me about your founders

Mayandi_Manzil was founded in 2018 by Chef Murugan and Lakshmi Murugan, a husband-wife team passionate about organic Tamil food. Chef Murugan learned traditional recipes from his grandmother in Madurai. Their vision: Make authentic, healthy Tamil food accessible to everyone while supporting organic farmers.
Do you employ organic farming graduates?

Yes! We employ agriculture graduates as quality controllers and farm liaison officers. We also conduct internship programs for hotel management students wanting to learn authentic Tamil cuisine and organic food handling. Education and skill development are important to us.
What is your busiest time?

Weekends (Saturday-Sunday) lunch time (12-3 PM) and Friday-Sunday dinner (7-10 PM) are our busiest hours. Festival days like Pongal, Diwali, and Tamil New Year see 3x regular crowd. We recommend advance booking for these times or visit during weekday afternoons for peaceful dining.
Do you celebrate Tamil New Year?

Yes! Tamil New Year (Puthandu/Chithirai) in April is celebrated grandly. We serve special: Mango Pachadi (6-taste dish), Neem flower rasam, special payasam, and traditional thali. Free Puthandu special sweet for all diners. We also decorate with mango leaves and conduct traditional music performances.
